description: Known-answer vectors for end-to-end encrypted team names, v1 (Pulse/docs/plans/07-11-2026-team-names-e2e-design.md §4.2): HPKE (RFC 9180) mode_auth with DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM; info = info_label || 0x00 || team_id || sender_id || recipient_id (UUIDs as 16 raw bytes); aad = 0x01; plaintext = I2OSP(len, 2) || utf8(name) || zeros to 512 bytes; sealed = 0x01 || enc || ct; name_tag = HMAC-SHA256(tag_secret, tag_label || 0x00 || utf8(name) || recipient_key_id || enc)[0:16]; key_id = SHA-256(public_key); the identity envelope is a Tessera v1 envelope under the VMK with context identity_context over 0x01 || d || pub || tag_secret. Ephemeral keys, DEKs and nonces are fixed here and random in production. Generated by a standard-library Go reference that reproduces RFC 9180 A.3.1, A.3.3, A.6.1 and A.6.3; every seal equals Cloudflare CIRCL's output for the same inputs. All hex.
